title: FlyLo own-platform LDAP, HTTPS and terminal integration
summary: FlyLo consumes project-owned platform identity, TLS and terminal facilities. Current source candidates are pinned exactly, but activation remains fail-closed until their live/runtime gates are satisfied.
policy: Public FlyLo access must terminate TLS in the project-owned ooRexx HTTPS Server.
Authenticated FlyLo identities must resolve through the project-owned LDAP Identity authority.
FlyLo must not copy LDAP credential truth into an application-local identity store.
External identity providers may federate only through platform authentication policy; they do not replace LDAP directory authority.
The MVS airline backend remains independently testable and does not acquire TLS or LDAP authority.
A current source artifact is not ACTIVE merely because it is newer.
